Backend: Custom template appears in GET list with custom: true field
Backend: GET returns both predefined (5) and custom templates
Backend: DELETE removes custom template from list
Backend: Custom templates are scoped to club_id
Backend: Custom template response has all required fields (id, name, description, icon, days, custom)
